fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Refuge dimensional adequacy for pedestrians and cyclists on wide A4019 arms serving a bus stop is a genuine Stage 1 VRU safety issue with a credible injury mechanism (clipping during two-way conflicts).
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim quote EV-UK-015 directly supports the pivotal refuge-width/cyclist-clipping risk at the named junctions, supplemented by a recorded Table 4-1 basis for the location assumption; only the bus-stop demand framing extends beyond the quote.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly raised as a categorical safety concern rather than a compliance claim, with no normative basis asserted, appropriate to DMRB GG 119 Stage 1 scope.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: identifies exact locations (each A4019 crossing adjacent the bus stop), required attributes (depth and width), and design users (expectant parent with pushchair plus cycle), all deliverable at detailed design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly identified as affected road users, the evidence quote addresses cyclist refuge containment, and the recommendation extends coverage to pushchair users.

justifications.substance: Stop-line repositioning near the Homecroft Drive junction can invalidate previously demonstrated large-vehicle swept paths that already show limited over-run; a genuine Stage 1 verification concern.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim quote in EV-UK-002 confirms the original swept-path analysis, the 7.5t box van/refuse vehicle types, and existing over-run into opposing lanes, directly grounding the pivotal re-validation claim.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a confirmation-style compliance question rather than an asserted safety problem, keeping categories distinct under GG 119 Stage 1 semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: re-run swept-path analysis for the named vehicle classes over the as-adjusted stop-line positions before Stage 2; viable and time-bound.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians, cyclists, central refuges, and desire lines are explicitly acknowledged, but VRU-specific exposure is deliberately out of scope for this vehicle-focused question, matching the acknowledge-but-not-applicable case.
